text:
Arjun: Heads-up — saw a customer report where requests get routed to a lower-dim model (256q) and the console just shows "fallback" with no context. They want to know why and how much extra cost it caused.
Marta: Ugh. We only emit a generic router_reason metric currently. No per-request payload about dims or estimated unit-cost.
Kevin: We do have embed.route.event in telemetry but it's sparse: typically {evt: "route", model: "embedding-2048", outcome: "fallback"}. Not enough for SRE or billing triage.
Sasha: Agree we should enrich it. Proposal: emit embed.route_fallback with fields: reason (dim_mismatch|capacity|quota), from_model, to_model, input_dims, input_bytes, estimated_cost_delta_usd.
Arjun: +1 on the shape. Also add a deterministic mapping for cost_estimate: use model.unit_cost_per_token * estimated_tokens where estimated_tokens = ceil(bytes/avg_bytes_per_token). Keep it cheap to compute in router.
Marta: UI question: do we surface cost delta in the console per request? Might freak customers if we show micro-costs. Maybe aggregate over timeframe and link to trace?
Kevin: We should show a small yellow pill on the request detail saying "Routed to embedding-256q (fallback)". Tooltip: reason + estimated 24h cost delta. And in route investigation view, expose a histogram of fallback rate + cumulative cost impact.
Sasha: Telemetry event contract (sketch):
```
{ "evt": "embed.route_fallback", "reason": "dim_mismatch", "from": "embed-2048-fp32", "to": "embed-256-ql8", "input_dims": 2048, "input_bytes": 15360, "estimated_tokens": 3072, "estimated_cost_delta_usd": "0.0012" }
```
Arjun: That looks fine but keep all fields strings in the event payload for downstream parsers? We should at least make reason/from/to strings; numeric dims/cost numeric is fine for telemetry. Our parquet pipeline expects types.
Marta: For quotas: if fallback is due to quota (e.g., reserved capacity exceeded), we should label reason "quota_fallback" and emit quota_id. Then the console can link to quota config and show recommendations (increase reserved / change route policy).
Kevin: UX note: when a model downgrade happens because of dims incompatibility (customer sent a mixed-dim batch), we should show an inline hint: "Mixed dims detected — we split into two calls and downgraded the larger items." Link to docs about how to fail-fast on mixed dims or let router split.
Sasha: Telemetry IDs we should add to event: trace_id, request_id, route_policy. That lets us join with traces and billing. Also include a boolean: user_visible (true if we want console to surface).
IngestBot: automated alert — embed.route_fallback spike: 212 events in last 5m for model embed-2048 -> embed-256-ql8 (reason: dim_mismatch).
Arjun: Good. Action items: (1) eng-runtime: emit enriched embed.route_fallback event (contract above) — Sasha to own. (2) console: show yellow pill + aggregated cost delta and link to traces — Marta to own. (3) eng-platform: add a small preflight check in the SDK to optionall fast-fail on mixed dims — Kevin to own.
Marta: One more: add a telemetry flag fallback.is_quota to help billing team count revenue leakage.
Kevin: Timeline: I'll prototype the SDK change this week, runtime event next week, console mockups early next sprint.
Sasha: I'll post the event schema to the telemetry channel and a sample query for datasets.
Arjun: Thanks everyone. If possible include a sample big-request example in the PR so console team can test the pill rendering.
Marta: noted, will add a tiny fixture and an expect test. :thumbsup:
IngestBot: note — linked incident 2026-03-19-embed-fallback-214 for related customer report.
